verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, OpenAI-like endpoints, and an Anthropic-compatible endpoint. None of it mentions official LM Studio client libraries or SDKs for Python or JavaScript. Calling those HTTP endpoints, or reusing third-party OpenAI SDKs against them, is an adjacent building block rather than an official client library, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the runtime from official client libraries in languages like Python or JavaScript
